visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a golden Daruma doll sitting on a dark brown ledge. A human hand holding a white marker pen enters from the right side of the frame, moving towards the doll's eye. The background is a window covered in raindrops, looking out onto a grey, overcast sky. (2) Sudden cut to a black Daruma doll with golden wave patterns on its base. It sits in the same position on the ledge. The lighting is diffused and soft, characteristic of a rainy day. (3) The camera cuts back to the golden Daruma. The hand with the white marker continues to hover and gesture near the doll's face as if drawing. (4) Rapid alternating jump cuts continue between the black and gold dolls. The gold doll has one pupil drawn in black while the other remains a blank white circle. (5) Final shot shows both the black and gold Daruma dolls positioned side-by-side on the ledge. Bright yellow subtitle text appears at the bottom center of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, playful electronic BGM plays. A male voice speaks with standard conversational pitch and moderate arousal. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs. A second male voice responds, pitch-shifted to be extremely high and sharp, delivering lines with rapid-fire speed and high arousal. (3) The first male voice returns with a slightly authoritative yet puzzled tone, explaining the tradition of the Daruma doll. The playful BGM remains steady in the background. (4) The second high-pitched voice asks a short question. (5) A final question is posed by the first voice. Upon the gold doll's response, the BGM immediately cuts to a high-energy J-pop rock track with distorted electric guitars and aggressive male vocals, signaling a dramatic comedic punchline.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To deliver a short comedy skit involving the personification of Daruma dolls, subverting the traditional meaning of drawing their eyes with a literal and absurd wish.
